text:
Priya: Free 34" QHD ultrawide monitor (3440x1440) + vintage wooden tea cart. Moving out of SoHo this weekend, both free for curbside pickup. Monitor powers on, no dead pixels, comes with power brick and one extra HDMI cable. Cart has one wobble caster that I can glue but otherwise solid. Pics: https://imgur.com/example :smile:
Ben: Interested in the monitor — would you share dimensions/weight? I have a small SUV but want to be sure it fits. :eyes:
Priya: Monitor w/stand is ~31 lbs, footprint ~32in wide x 14in deep. Stand removable (I'll take it off if that helps). Cart is about 30in long, rolls fine but one wheel needs a quick tighten.
Olivia: If Ben passes on the monitor I'm happy to take it. Saturday morning works for me.
Jamal: I can grab the cart Saturday around 12:30 and bring a screwdriver for the caster. @Priya where exactly in SoHo?
Priya: Two blocks from Houston & Mercer. I'll be home Sat 9-2. If multiple people want stuff I can split times — prefer curbside pickup only (no stairs).
Ben: I can do Saturday 9:30 pickup. I'll DM my car details. Can you remove the stand or would you rather I take it whole?
Priya: I'll remove the stand and tape the screen. I'll leave the monitor boxed on the stoop at 9:15 and put a sticky note with Ben's name. Please DM when en route. :raised_hands:
LogisticsBot: FYI — street parking permit required for vehicle width >6ft in SoHo between 8am-4pm. See https://cityparking.example/permit
Alex: If anything's left later I can come by after 3pm. Also if someone needs an extra HDMI cable I'm happy to grab it. :)
Ben: Confirmed — I'll be there 9:30 and will text when I'm 5 mins out. Thanks @Priya! :thumbsup:
Priya: Great, thanks all. Ben gets the monitor, Jamal gets the cart, Olivia I'll keep in mind if Ben needs to reschedule. Leaving one extra HDMI cable with monitor.
Olivia: Sweet — congrats Ben! And thanks Priya for the handoff plan.
Priya: You're welcome — hope they get good homes. :)
